name: PathSpeed!
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: Nikrecs
description: Walk faster on paths and roads — a server-side speed boost where every block gets its own speed, so better road materials are genuinely faster. Works on vanilla clients with no client install.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers. Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln development build 2026-11-20 (eda5a4a5) (26 classes, 56 members). Not run yet.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers
